'''Benjamin Daria''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[April 2000 Williston Park tournament]] on 15 April 2000 with High destiny Dr. Evazan deck (Hoth Defensive Perimeter start), according to Brad Vogel's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d527">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-15-williston-park-new-york-4-15-00d527/ williston-park-new-york-4-15-00], DeckTech (Brad "Uncle Chall" Vogel, 15 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-15-williston-park-new-york-4-15-00d527/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
